g.text: INITIAL ISSUE. REPLACES REV B SKETCHES
HOST POWER: MAINS ADAPTER OR BATTERY
ONE CABLE. NO OTHER ELECTRICAL CONNECTIONS
56 KILOHM PULL-UP TO VBUS INSIDE P1
CABLE SHIELD, BONDED AT BOTH ENDS
W1 CONNECTS A1-J1 DIRECTLY TO A HOST PORT. NO UNPOWERED HUB.
TOTAL USB CABLE LENGTH 3 m MAX WITHOUT AN ACTIVE EXTENSION.
A1 IS POWERED FROM J1 ONLY. SUPPLY CURRENT IS NOT PUBLISHED
BY THE MANUFACTURER. MEASURE IT (TEST HB-3).
A1-J2 TO J5 ARE NOT CONNECTED (NC). NO SOLDERING.
FL1 IS FITTED ONLY IF INTERFERENCE IS SEEN ON THE AUDIO.
PLACE IT WITHIN 50 mm OF P1 AND TIE IT IN PLACE.
PIN ASSIGNMENTS ARE THOSE OF A STANDARD USB 2.0 TYPE-C TO
TYPE-A CABLE. W1 IS A PURCHASED PART AND IS NOT MODIFIED.
CONNECTOR DESIGNATORS ON A1 ARE ASSIGNED BY THIS DRAWING.
THEY ARE NOT THE MANUFACTURER'S MARKINGS.
THE FOUR RAW MICROPHONES ARE CAPTURE CHANNELS 2 TO 5,
COUNTING FROM 0, OF THE 6 CHANNEL 16 kHz USB AUDIO STREAM.
